children: ICICI Securities's research report on Apollo Tyres

Apollo Tyres (APTY)’s Q2 EBITDAM (consol.) was 60bps below our estimate due to weaker-than-expected profitability for EU operations on muted demand. The company took 11–13% price hike in H1 to partially mitigate the impact of RM inflation and it intends to take multiple price hikes in the near term. Current demand momentum remains healthy in India biz., though we expect growth to moderate during H2 given a high base and steep price hike(s). Restructuring of EU operations could structurally improve profitability for APTY during H2. Current capacity utilisation remains high (~90%). Higher capex during FY27–29 towards India capacity expansion may drag FCF. However, it could support medium-term growth.
We cut our FY27E margin by 40bps but maintain it for FY28–29. Retain BUY; TP revised to INR 500 (vs. INR 515), basis on 15x Sep’28E EPS.
